target.title: ci: unify Matrix release QA
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Matrix release QA had a standalone release-check job that duplicated the canonical QA Live workflow, invoked the Matrix-only CLI directly, and maintained separate retry, artifact, and status aggregation logic. That let the release path drift from the shared live adapter and from the six parity-proven Matrix scenarios added by #101112.

## Why This Change Was Made

Route the release Matrix gate through the reusable `QA-Lab - All Lanes` workflow and its canonical `qa suite --channel-driver live --channel matrix` path. The caller keeps focused `qa-live-matrix` selection, exact-SHA validation, two attempts, strict artifacts, and fail-closed status propagation to the release verifier. Manual transport/media/E2EE profiles remain on the exhaustive Matrix-specific runner, and reachable older refs that predate the live adapter feature-detect and fall back to the legacy `fast` profile.

This deletes the standalone release orchestration without deleting the broader Matrix inventory. It also removes unnecessary secret inheritance and the obsolete release-only canary timeout override.

## User Impact

Release managers get one canonical Matrix QA Live path and one artifact/status contract instead of a separate release-only implementation. Focused Matrix reruns still use `live_suite_filter=qa-live-matrix`; full manual Matrix inventory remains available with `matrix_profile=all`. Older release branches and tags remain testable through the bounded compatibility fallback.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwx19mxcc9z7z2q8d8dd09w8` (`coral-hermit`):
  - `corepack pnpm test test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts -t "routes release Matrix through canonical QA Live"` — passed.
  - `corepack pnpm test test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts` — 35/35 passed.
  - `corepack pnpm check:workflows` — actionlint/zizmor passed.
- Fresh Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwx2vms5976zsz9zxaa9jvqp` (`amber-hermit`):
  - `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed` — docs/tooling lanes passed with 0 lint warnings/errors.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Codex autoreview (`gpt-5.5`, high) — final run clean with no accepted/actionable findings after fixing release-ref trust, missing-status fail-closed behavior, and older-ref compatibility.
- Exact PR head: `d9724f8334051374a685369bfb3472212b33f054`.
